cursor.commands.name: Analyze Requirements
cursor.commands.description: Analyze requirement documents and generate reports
cursor.commands.prompt:
Using @agents/requirements-analyzer/prompt.md, analyze all requirement documents in docs/ directory and generate:
1. Use case diagram (PlantUML)
2. Requirements traceability matrix
3. Comprehensive requirement report
4. Gap analysis and recommendations

Save all outputs to architecture/requirements/ directory.

cursor.commands.name: Generate Architecture Diagrams
cursor.commands.prompt:
Using @agents/architecture-analyzer/prompt.md and @agents/diagram-generator/prompt.md:
1. Analyze the codebase structure
2. Identify architecture patterns
3. Generate C4 Context diagram
4. Generate C4 Container diagram
5. Generate C4 Component diagrams for main services
6. Create Mermaid flowchart showing data flow

Save all diagrams to architecture/diagrams/ directory.

cursor.commands.name: Design API
cursor.commands.description: Design REST API with OpenAPI specification
cursor.commands.prompt:
Using @agents/api-designer/prompt.md, design a complete REST API:
1. Identify resources from requirements
2. Design CRUD endpoints
3. Generate OpenAPI 3.0 specification
4. Create sequence diagrams for key flows
5. Define request/response schemas
6. Include authentication and error handling

Save to architecture/api/ directory.

cursor.commands.name: Create Database Diagrams
cursor.commands.prompt:
Using @agents/database-visualizer/prompt.md:
1. Analyze database schema requirements
2. Design database schema with tables and relationships
3. Generate Mermaid ER diagram
4. Generate PlantUML ER diagram
5. Generate DBML schema
6. Create comprehensive schema documentation

Save to architecture/database/ directory.

cursor.commands.name: Complete Architecture Documentation
cursor.commands.prompt:
Create comprehensive architecture documentation:
1. Use Requirements Analyzer for requirements
2. Use Architecture Analyzer for system overview
3. Use Diagram Generator for all diagram types
4. Use API Designer for API documentation
5. Use Database Visualizer for data models
6. Compile into architecture/README.md

Include:
- System overview
- Architecture decisions
- All diagrams
- API documentation
- Database schema
- Deployment guide
